targets.generic: Any other agent (Aider, Cline, opencode, Gemini CLI, plain prompts)

council.description: Decision council: optimist, skeptic, engineer, business and client agents debate a question in rounds and vote with confidence; a moderator checks the evidence and tallies against a 60 % threshold. Run with /council-vote. Every debate is logged to ~/knowledge/council.

crew.description: Dev crew: planner, skeptic, coder, web-coder, ui-builder, tester, reviewer and docs-writer agents, each with its own model and effort, plus /crew-ship (plan → challenge → your OK → code → test → review) and /crew-check (test + review before commit).

office.description: Business crew for freelancers and small teams: researcher, quote-builder, pricing-analyst, outreach-writer, copywriter, lead-scout, job-scout and librarian agents, plus /office-setup, /office-quote, /office-outreach, /office-learn and the lead, site and job desks. Agents answer from your ~/knowledge base and never send, submit or publish anything.
